note: Dubuque County Conservation park on Mississippi River Pool 11, about 15 mi north of Dubuque off the Great River Road (C9Y), with a marina and boat ramp. The camping loop sits in wooded bottomland south of the railroad, beside the creek channel that feeds the marina; the river views are from the bluff trails. Water and the shower house are off about November 1 to May 1. Ranger in residence year-round. --Claude
summary: Rate added: $30 (50-amp/water). Confirmed reservable for ~30% (7 sites) via MyCountyParks, rest FCFS; showers, dump, water. Added 50-amp, 24 sites, pad lengths 33-55 ft (max 30 -> 55). Waterfront lead: riverview -> not waterfront.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (riverview -> not waterfront, a downgrade): on NAIP the camping loop is 170-200 m south of the Mississippi, with the railroad embankment, the park's parking lot and a belt of trees between, so the river is not in view from the pads (the county itself places the views on the trails: 'Scenic views of the river await those who follow the nature trails up the rugged bluffs'). The only water beside the sites is the narrow creek channel west of the loop and the marina basin by sites 1-4 (about 13-20 m wide, creek-sized), with the park road between the basin and the sites; the west-side sites are 20-30 m from the creek under canopy and cannot be shown on its bank. Overpass was down (imagery estimates).
MAX RIG 30 -> 55: the stored 30 ft (note prose) is contradicted by the county's per-site pages, which post back-in gravel pads of 33-55 ft at the seven reservable sites.

SEASON not written: the park page's 'Operating Hours & Seasons: April through November 1st 6:30am until 10:30pm' reads as park hours; the site pages say 'Water and modern shower/restroom facilities are closed approximately from November 1st through May 1st.' Neither is a campground opening statement, so season stays unknown.
RATE TEXT: site 01's body still says 'Camping Rate : $23.00/per night' while its header and the other six sites say $30. Used $30.
PIN (~160 m off, under the 250 m line): 42.65400,-90.80600 is in the woods by the ranger residence north-east of the loop; the camping loop's centre is about 42.6530,-90.8075.
